## Welcome

I am a graduate student in the **MRes in Economics** at **Sciences Po, Paris**. I obtained my BA in Economics at **Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST)** in Ghana.

My research interests are in **Development, Environmental, and Public Economics and Political Economy**, with an empirical focus on Sub-Saharan Africa. My master's thesis, titled *Roads, Market Access and Forest Loss: Evidence from Ghana*, is supervised by **[Prof. Clément Imbert](https://sites.google.com/site/clemimbert/)**.
